fire: Nicotine triggers the release of adrenaline from the adrenal glands.
The vagus nerve signals to the stomach to begin secreting acid.
Statins block the enzyme that the liver uses to make cholesterol.
Growth hormone prompts the liver to produce IGF-1.
Antihistamines suppress the body's response to pollen.
Melatonin tells the brain that it is time to sleep.
Vitamin D helps the gut absorb calcium from food.
Cortisol instructs the liver to release stored glucose.
quiet: Adrenaline is a hormone produced by the adrenal glands.
The vagus nerve runs from the brainstem down to the abdomen.
Cholesterol is a waxy substance found in every cell of the body.
Growth hormone levels are highest during deep sleep.
Pollen counts are typically highest in the early morning.
Melatonin is sold over the counter in most pharmacies.
Calcium is the most abundant mineral in the human body.
The liver is the largest internal organ in the body.
